description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Kodama of the East Tree, Spark Double, and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Spark Double and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Spark Double token's trigger, putting Dimir Aqueduct onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Dimir Aqueduct trigger.
Repeat from step 5.
